summary: World-sensitive final file-change rules I–V; independent file domains, exact condition B, local extended NFC and contextual truth. General invariance and existential-force proofs, with no added logical axioms.
implementation_scope: Explicit rules and theorems implemented; open source policies/grammar are interfaces, not complete predictions.

sources.citation: Heim, I. (1982). The Semantics of Definite and Indefinite Noun Phrases. Consulted edition: Schoubye–Glick 2011 retypesetting. III.1.4 pp.185–190; III.2.1.1 pp.196–198; pp.202,214–218,234,236–238; p.254 fn.28.
sources.available: Local primary-source passages read. Independent semantic review pending.

definitions_mapped.source: Infinite assignments, independent domains/satisfaction, world projection, and the source's single-coordinate condition B.
Finite-arity tuples and semantic LF syntax; not the full grammar of English.
Final rules I–IV at p.234 and proposed disjunction V at p.254 fn.28; factorized existential/disjunction is proved equivalent.
Local extended NFC, complex descriptive entailment and mathematically partial updates represented by a guard.
Criterion C on pp.214–218, not a solution of C′ for false contexts.
Stronger full-domain support and pointwise equality; kept distinct from B.

evidence: World-sensitive final file-change rules I–V; independent file domains, exact condition B, local extended NFC and contextual truth. General invariance and existential-force proofs, with no added logical axioms.
Source-complete approval is withheld; this self-assessment does not authenticate independent review.
omissions: No automatic choice of LF, referent or accommodation policy.
Felicity covers the named semantic checks, not all pragmatic acceptability.
Criterion C′ and modal/indexed semantics are in companion modules, not blended into these final rules.
additions: Finite-arity tuples and semantic LF syntax; not the full grammar of English.
Stronger full-domain support and pointwise equality; kept distinct from B.

determination_rationale: The explicit mathematical semantics has substantial checked support. Unresolved pragmatic policies, general grammar coverage and the source clarification are recorded, not silently repaired or converted into a necessity-of-restructuring verdict. Source-level approval remains pending.

artifact_classes.description: Explicit file/domain, finite-arity syntax and relational interfaces are representation infrastructure; no changed predictions are inferred from their addition.
Arbitrary satisfaction/entailment has no supplied decision procedure. A total executable resolver would require additional capabilities or a declared restricted model.
